attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy

rules.alternatives: Certified pharmacy technicians must hold certification from a Board-approved certifying body (247 CMR 8.04); keeping it follows the certifier's own CE rules.
rules.notes: License renews without a CE requirement: 247 CMR 8.07 sets only expiry every two years on the licensee's birthdate and timely renewal; the CE rule (247 CMR 4.03) applies to pharmacist registrations.
rules.rule_quote: (1) A pharmacy technician license shall expire every two years on the birthdate of the licensee.
